d:
Dice Media brings you Ye Saali Naukri — a raw and relatable take on India’s great middle-class struggle: naukri ki talaash.
Meet Raviranjan Kumar – part-time YouTuber, full-time government job aspirant, and a guy stuck between dreams and deadlines. Whether it's chai tapri gyaan or late-night vlogging, Ravi's heart is set on cracking the OSC exam… so he can finally marry his girlfriend Jyoti.
But dreams alone don’t clear sarkari exams, and society doesn’t make it any easier.
